sources.supports: Sun is a star; planets orbit the Sun; sunlight warms Earth.
Solar system includes the Sun and planets; our solar system belongs to the Milky Way.
Jupiter is the largest solar-system planet; stripe patterns are atmosphere/cloud belts.
Saturn's rings comprise pieces of ice and rock; ring plane drawn with correct front/rear occlusion.
The Milky Way is a huge galaxy containing many stars and our solar system, not another planet.

diagramNote: An introductory collection and orbit demonstration, not all eight planets. Images, positions, sizes, distances, speeds and orbital radii are illustrative and not to scale. The Milky Way drawing is a separate far-scale galaxy schematic, not a planet or a real view alongside the nearby planets. Any background audio is an imaginative musical track, not sound transmitted through vacuum.
art: Original builtin ImageGen painted globe cutouts, distant galaxy schematic and starfield panorama. Existing V4.8 Mars cutout is reused without modifying its source. Stars are deterministic vector geometry rendered as lossless transparent WebP. No mesh or image-part slicing.
